# who.michitai.com

> Free domain intelligence: WHOIS/RDAP registration data, live DNS records and
> IP network intelligence for any domain — with cached, hash-deduped history.
> No account, no API key. Copyright (c) 2026 Nichita Levandovici.
> All rights reserved.

Author: Nichita Levandovici (MICHITAI)
Contact: support@michitai.com

## Endpoints (all public, GET-only)

- `GET /api/lookup/{domain}` — full report: registration (RDAP first, WHOIS
  port-43 fallback), DNS (A/AAAA/MX/NS/CNAME/TXT/CAA/SOA), IP intelligence
  (PTR, network, origin ASN). `?fresh=1` bypasses cache.
- `GET /api/lookup/{domain}/history` — append-only snapshots.
  `?kind=registration|dns|ip`, `?limit=N` (default 50).
- `GET /lookup/{domain}` — human-readable report page.

## Machine-readable

- [OpenAPI 3.0 spec](https://who.michitai.com/openapi.json): endpoints,
  parameters and response schemas
- [Full reference](https://who.michitai.com/llms-full.txt): complete docs in
  one file — response shapes, caching semantics, error catalogue

## Behavior notes

- Domains are normalized to lowercase punycode (IDN-safe) before lookup.
- Results are cached: registration/IP 24h, DNS ~30min. Identical payloads
  extend the snapshot TTL in place — history rows mean real changes.
- Errors: 400 invalid domain, 502 upstream failure.
- Fair use: no key required — please don't hammer `?fresh=1`.
